note: What a SESSION varies on top of the fixed city. The city itself is drawn in city-plan.json and baked; nothing here can move a street.

turf.note: One manor per gang, anchored on the place it is named for. Territory grows out from these over dry land only, so a manor is a piece of the city rather than a wedge of the square.

homes.where: Kessler Row — the Port Vasco docks, under the power station
Sunnyside — the Sunridge suburbs and the flats behind them
The Quay — the Terraces and the south shore below them
Halloran — Ravenhill, off the building they took the name from
Marrow Street — the Old Quarter, where the alleys are
